cases.knownGap: OPEN (contained by P0): the override vocabulary lists 13 languages; Swahili is not one. A short instruction in an unlisted language is treated as data and, before P0, was shown to the model. Since P0 no V1 deal calls a model, so the exposure is closed for V1 and REOPENS when stage P4 enables models for V2 deals. The defences then are withholding the column (opaque columns) and human review.

probes.title: Seller runs as a separate OS process whose environment contains none of the parent's secret-named variables
probes.evidence: seller pid 17184 != lab pid 11044; seller sees 0 sensitive env names; the lab process sees 14

probes.title: Buyer/seller code imports no database, PayPal, settlement, signing, ledger, budget, orchestration or verification module
Orchestration and verification code import no PayPal, gateway, settlement-engine, budget or signing module
The Attack Lab itself imports no real PayPal client or REST gateway (it can only reach the in-memory mock)
The buyer agent's context is deep-frozen: attempts to alter its ceiling, history or task throw
Simulated seller services listen on loopback only
OS-level sandboxing of the seller process
probes.evidence: The seller is a separate process with a minimal environment and import boundaries. It shares the machine and the OS user with the rest of the system, can read any file that user can read, and is not in a container, jail, seccomp profile or VM. It is NOT a secure OS sandbox, and no probe here claims otherwise. In Gates 3-5 the seller supplies data only: no seller code is ever executed by the system.
